integrity: Analytic triple-integral proof accompanied by exact-rational rank enumeration and exact integer-coordinate geometric sign examples. Finite checker evidence is supplemental.
scientific_limitations: Finite fixed planar sites in general position, iid continuous heights and horizontal Voronoi visibility only. Neither Poisson-site averaging nor independent mathematical validation is established. Historical priority may be revised if an earlier equivalent joint-event theorem is found.
title: Exact incident-edge covariance and conditional degree variance in horizontal Voronoi visibility graphs
